import sys
from bisect import bisect_left

n, d = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
h = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))

indices = [0]
dp = [h[0]]

for i in range(1, n):
    if h[i] >= dp[-1] + d:
        dp.append(h[i])
        indices.append(i)
    else:
        pos = bisect_left(dp, h[i] - d + 1)
        if dp[pos] > h[i]:
            dp[pos] = h[i]
            indices[pos] = i

print(len(indices))
print(' '.join(map(lambda x: str(x + 1), indices)))
